meta.title: Room Schedule & Cost · AI Data Center
meta.description: AI data center construction schedule and CAPEX/OPEX comparison for air and liquid cooling.

copy.scheduleIntro: Compare typical on-site durations and parallel workstreams across delivery options.
copy.costIntro: Compare infrastructure, ICT investment and operating electricity for air and liquid cooling at the same card count.
copy.comparisonIntro: Higher initial ICT investment is offset by lower facility power and long-term electricity cost.
copy.formulaText: ICT power = cards × power/card; facility power = ICT power × PUE; L0+L1 = facility MW × 10⁶ × $/W; OPEX = facility MW × 1000 × 8760 × electricity price × years.
copy.countryIntro: Standardized at 1,024 cards and five-year electricity OPEX; card power, PUE and ICT unit prices remain at the air/liquid defaults.
copy.parallelText: Total duration ≠ the simple sum of all phases
copy.scope: Scope: on-site construction / retrofit, commissioning and acceptance only
copy.disclaimer: Planning estimate · Typical range for medium-to-large projects · Actual duration and cost vary by scale, site conditions and equipment delivery

errors.generic: Invalid inputs. Correct the highlighted fields to calculate.
errors.cards: Card count must be a number of at least 1.
errors.infraPerW: L0+L1 unit cost must be a number of at least 0.
errors.electricity: Electricity price must be a number of at least 0.
errors.years: Operating years must be a number of at least 1.
errors.cardPower: Power per card must be a number of at least 0.
errors.unitCost: ICT unit cost must be a number of at least 0.
